consent.title: First, a quick live selfie
consent.subtitle: It keeps fake profiles out. It takes about 10 seconds.
consent.realBody: We check that a live person is in front of the camera.
consent.privateTitle: Only our safety team can see it
consent.privateBody: It is stored privately and encrypted.
consent.agree: I agree to live selfie verification.
consent.agreeLabel: I agree to live selfie verification
consent.sheet1: We compare a short live video to check that a real person is taking it, and that your main profile photo shows the same person.
consent.sheet2: Only our safety team and our verification partner can see it. It is encrypted and never shown on your profile or to other people.
consent.sheet3: We keep it while your account is open, and delete it when you delete your account.

selfie.turnLeft: Turn your head slowly to the left

blocked.caption: Blocked people can't see your profile or message you, and they are not told. If you unblock someone, your old match does not come back.

blocked.actionError: We couldn't unblock them. Please try again.

safety.title: Safety centre
safety.heroBody: A few simple habits keep first dates safe and fun.
safety.publicBody: Cafes and busy areas are best
safety.reportingBody: Report someone from their profile or your chat. Our safety team reviews every report. The person is never told who reported them, and we don't share the outcome. Blocking takes effect straight away.
safety.verificationBody: Everyone takes a live selfie when they join, so every profile belongs to a real person. Only our safety team can see it, and it's never shown on a profile. The optional ID badge confirms age and identity without us keeping your document.
